title: Choose Utu's visual world
question: Keep Attention Rounds, choose a challenger, or re-roll with a steer.

options.label: Attention Rounds
options.lineage: clinical shift handoff and triage boards
options.thesis: Every agent becomes a concise case handoff: evidence, urgency, owner, and next action.
options.viewport: A quiet left rail opens onto one large attention field: needs-you cases lead, live work runs alongside, and fleet health closes the scan.
options.risk: The clinical lineage can feel severe if routine work is written like an emergency.

options.label: Night Cross-check
options.thesis: A fixed constellation of instruments makes every operational truth cross-checkable at a glance.
options.viewport: Six ranked status instruments own attention, activity, cost, authentication, isolation, and delivery while project detail unfolds below.
options.case: Strong technical recognition and excellent cross-check clarity; loses on the light operating scene and broad project hierarchy.
options.risk: Its near-black panel conflicts with the requested lightness and can reduce complex work to six headline readings.

options.label: Live Character Field
options.lineage: live scenes rendered as typewriter characters
options.thesis: The entire fleet resolves into one living character grid whose density reveals activity and exceptions.
options.viewport: A selectable glyph field maps every active agent and project, with one focused handoff rendered legibly beside it.
options.case: Immediately identifies with CLI operators; loses product clarity when tasks, costs, and health compete inside one glyph system.
options.risk: The terminal grammar can make cloud agents feel secondary and dense operational details harder to compare.

options.label: Sixteen-color Workbench
options.thesis: Fixed functional regions swap content without moving the operator's learned map.
options.viewport: A permanent project field, attention window, and agent portrait strip update cell by cell without layout drift.
options.case: Distinct, stateful, and performance-minded; loses audience identification by reading as nostalgic game software.
options.risk: Its retro character can overpower the seriousness of permissions, costs, and execution isolation.

canonCard.label: Polished SaaS Console
canonCard.thesis: A conventional light sidebar, metric cards, tables, and filters executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A left navigation rail, headline metrics, recent agent activity, and an issues table in the expected arrangement.
canonCard.risk: Highly familiar, but the product's provider-neutral attention mechanism becomes visually interchangeable with ordinary admin software.
